title: Waverly Place Double Glass Shelf with Gallery Rail - 16-Inch Wall Mount Solid Brass Hardware | Allied Brass
body_html:
Add polished, space-saving storage with this 16-inch double glass shelf, designed with a gallery rail to help keep everyday items in place and a wall-mounted profile that clears your countertop.

  • Double-tier design: ideal use of space for toiletries and accessories
  • Tempered glass: 3/8-inch thick for strength and safety
  • Gallery rail: helps keep items secure on each shelf
  • Solid brass hardware: crafted from the finest brass materials
  • Clean installation: concealed screw mounting hardware

Specs

  • Glass dimensions: 16 x 5 inches
  • Overall dimensions: 16 in (L) x 8 in (H) x 5 in projection
  • Weight capacity: 4 lb
  • Mounting type: Wall mount
  • Included: Glass shelf and all installation hardware
  • Assembly required: No

Design coordination

  • Part of the Waverly Place collection for matching Waverly Place, transitional bath accessories
  • Available in 28 designer finishes, including statement options such as Glokzin Teal, Venetian Bronze, Lavender, Mediterranean Blue, and Sea Foam Green

_previous.description: Add a flare of style to your décor with this decorative glass shelf. Shelf can be used anywhere in the home for a great space to store your products. Gallery rail will keep your items secure. Tempered glass is 3/8 Inches thick and all of the hardware is made of solid brass and finished with the highest quality materials to provide a lifetime of beauty.
